subject: chemistry
title: Acidic, basic and amphoteric oxides
key_idea: Oxides of non-metals are mostly acidic. Oxides of metals are basic. Some oxides, such as aluminium oxide and zinc oxide, are amphoteric: they react with both acids and bases to make a salt and water.

blocks.text: The type of oxide depends on whether the element is a metal or a non-metal. This section covers each type.

items.meaning: An oxide of a non-metal. It reacts with bases to form a salt and water.
An oxide of a metal. It reacts with acids to form a salt and water.

rows: Sulfur dioxide, SO₂; carbon dioxide, CO₂; silicon(IV) oxide, SiO₂
Copper(II) oxide, CuO; calcium oxide, CaO

items: A few non-metal oxides, such as carbon monoxide, are neutral.
Acidic oxides that dissolve in water give solutions with a pH less than 7.
Basic oxides react with acids and are neutralised by them.
A reaction between a basic oxide and an acidic oxide is an acid–base reaction.
Calcium oxide reacting with silicon(IV) oxide to make calcium silicate is an example.
Elements can be classified by their oxides. A metal forms a basic oxide and conducts electricity. A non-metal forms an acidic oxide and does not conduct electricity (graphite is an exception).
Non-metal oxides are acidic. Metal oxides are basic.
Acidic oxides have a pH below 7 when dissolved in water.
A basic oxide and an acidic oxide react in an acid–base reaction.

blocks.text: (Supplement) Some oxides are neither purely acidic nor purely basic. This section covers amphoteric oxides.

items.meaning: An oxide that reacts with acids and with bases to produce a salt and water.

items: (Supplement) Aluminium oxide, Al₂O₃, and zinc oxide, ZnO, are amphoteric.
(Supplement) With an acid, they act as a base.
(Supplement) With a base such as aqueous sodium hydroxide, they act as an acid.
(Supplement) Both reactions make a salt and water only.

items: (Supplement) An amphoteric oxide reacts with both acids and bases.
(Supplement) The products are always a salt and water.

checks.q: State the type of oxide that copper(II) oxide is.
checks.a: Copper(II) oxide is a basic oxide.

checks.q: (Supplement) State the meaning of the term amphoteric.
checks.a: It reacts with acids and with bases to produce a salt and water.
Sulfur dioxide, carbon dioxide or silicon(IV) oxide.

worked_example.question: SnO₂ is an amphoteric oxide. SnO₂ reacts with aqueous sodium hydroxide, NaOH, to form a sodium salt and water only. The sodium salt contains a negative ion with the formula SnO₃²⁻. Write the symbol equation for the reaction between SnO₂ and NaOH.
worked_example.tip: Balance the sodium: two Na⁺ ions balance one SnO₃²⁻ ion.
